module.app_service_environments:data.external.ase_ilb_ip already references the outputs of module.app_service_environments:resource.azurerm_template_deployment.ase in its program argument, so the explicit depends_on duplicates the inferred ordering.

module.app_service_environments:resource.azurerm_private_dns_a_record.a_records already depends on module.app_service_environments:resource.azurerm_template_deployment.ase transitively through data.external.ase_ilb_ip. The explicit dependency on the deployment is redundant.

module.azuread_applications:resource.null_resource.grant_admin_consent references module.azuread_applications:resource.azuread_service_principal.app in its provisioner environment, which already establishes the ordering duplicated by depends_on.

module.recovery_vaults:resource.azurerm_site_recovery_replication_policy.policy already references module.recovery_vaults:resource.azurerm_recovery_services_vault.asr_rg_vault.name through recovery_vault_name. Its explicit dependency on that vault is redundant.

module.virtual_wans.module.hubs:resource.azurerm_express_route_gateway.er_gateway sets virtual_hub_id from module.virtual_wans.module.hubs:resource.azurerm_virtual_hub.vwan_hub.id, so depends_on repeats an existing implicit dependency.

module.virtual_wans.module.hubs:resource.azurerm_point_to_site_vpn_gateway.p2s_gateway already references module.virtual_wans.module.hubs:resource.azurerm_virtual_hub.vwan_hub.id in virtual_hub_id. The explicit dependency on the hub is redundant.

module.virtual_wans.module.hubs:resource.azurerm_point_to_site_vpn_gateway.p2s_gateway already references module.virtual_wans.module.hubs:resource.azurerm_vpn_server_configuration.p2s_configuration[0].id in vpn_server_configuration_id. The explicit dependency on that configuration is redundant.

module.virtual_wans.module.hubs:resource.azurerm_vpn_gateway.s2s_gateway sets virtual_hub_id from module.virtual_wans.module.hubs:resource.azurerm_virtual_hub.vwan_hub.id, so the explicit depends_on duplicates the inferred dependency.

module.aks_clusters:resource.azurerm_kubernetes_cluster.aks enables managed Azure AD integration but has no ordering dependency on module.aks_clusters:resource.null_resource.register_aks_msi_preview_feature, whose provisioner registers and waits for the AAD-V2 feature. Cluster creation can race that registration. Make the cluster depend on completion of the registration provisioner.

For VNet-injected deployments, module.databricks_workspaces:resource.azurerm_databricks_workspace.ws requires NSGs to be associated with its public and private subnets before provisioning. Its networking references only reach exported VNet/subnet resources, not module.networking:resource.azurerm_subnet_network_security_group_association.nsg_vnet_association, so workspace creation can race the associations and destruction can remove them too early. Carry association completion through the networking outputs or explicitly order the Databricks module after completion of the networking module.

When an AKS subnet has a configured route table, particularly for kubenet or userDefinedRouting, module.aks_clusters:resource.azurerm_kubernetes_cluster.aks must wait for module.networking:resource.azurerm_subnet_route_table_association.rt. The exported subnet IDs do not depend on the association, so cluster provisioning can start before the required routing is attached. Carry association readiness through the subnet output or add appropriate module-level ordering.

:module.synapse_workspaces creates four Key Vault secrets when generating SQL administrator credentials, but unlike the other secret-writing modules it does not wait for :module.keyvault_access_policies. Referencing the vault ID only establishes vault existence, not the executing principal's secret permissions. When those permissions are supplied by the configured access policies, secret creation can race the grants; add module-level ordering on the access-policy module.
